scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @hpt/client && npm run build --workspace @hpt/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @hpt/server
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names server,client --prefix-colors green,cyan --kill-others-on-fail "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
